label: Promise a rallying bounty
effects_text: Pay 7 gold; gain 8 morale.
reason: A promised bounty steadies the wavering line.

label: Commit the available reserve
effects_text: Commit actual reserve personnel to the line; gain 3 morale.
reason: The waiting reserve reinforces the wavering flank.

label: Contract the line
effects_text: Hold with 10% less action power today; preserve gold.
reason: The line contracts and gives ground to keep its order.

label: Approve the noble charge
effects_text: Attack with 15% more action power and 15% greater incoming exposure today.
reason: The nobles charge under the lawful attack order and expose their own line.

label: Keep the nobles organizing the line
effects_text: Preserve the current lawful order; the vain commander resents the refusal.
reason: The nobles remain to organize the line instead of charging.

label: Commit the reinforcements
effects_text: Release the actual waiting reinforcement to fight; gain 2 morale.
reason: The arriving regiment joins the fighting line.

label: Keep the reinforcements in reserve
effects_text: The arriving regiment remains out of attacking strength until committed.
reason: The arriving regiment waits as a real reserve.

label: Detail an escort for the wounded
effects_text: Devote 15% of action power to clearing the wounded road today; hold movement today.
reason: Fit personnel clear and guard the wounded road before the withdrawal.

label: Halt the withdrawal to clear the road
effects_text: Delay withdrawal one day; lose 2 morale; protect every wounded soldier.
reason: The column waits for the wounded to clear its departure road.

label: Detail men to collect the food
effects_text: Take at most 100 actual enemy food units; devote 15% of action power to collection today.
reason: A guarded party takes food from the captured enemy train.

label: Destroy the captured food and keep moving
effects_text: Destroy at most 100 actual enemy food units; take none.
reason: The captured enemy food is destroyed and the line keeps its strength.

label: Stop and shore the tunnel
effects_text: Pay 7 gold and 20 timber; stop work for shoring.
reason: The dangerous tunnel work stops for shoring.

label: Stop the dangerous work
effects_text: Stop tunnel work; preserve the crew and treasury.
reason: The crew abandons the unsafe tunnel.

label: Leave the food and report its position
effects_text: Leave every food unit untouched; report under the current agreement.
reason: The commander leaves the food untouched and reports its position under the agreement.

label: Report that the decision has lapsed

reason: The affected regiment is no longer available; the unexecuted decision is closed and reported.
